item.title: Middle East war live: Hezbollah chief demands 'comprehensive' Lebanon ceasefire, Israeli withdrawal
item.description: Hezbollah on Thursday rejected a ceasefire plan agreed by the Lebanese and Israeli governments in US-mediated talks, demanding that Israel withdraw its troops from southern Lebanon. Meanwhile, Israeli strikes killed at least four people, according to local authorities, and a UN peacekeeper was killed in the crossfire. Follow our liveblog for all the latest.

item.title: Trump's acknowledgment of Hezbollah 'utterly humiliating' for Netanyahu
item.description: Israel continued to strike southern Lebanon on Tuesday as Iran-backed Hezbollah attacked its troops there despite an apparent Washington-brokered de-escalation deal and a fourth round of US-hosted talks between Lebanon and Israel. FRANCE 24's Jerusalem correspondent Noga Tarnopolsky explains that "on the Israeli side we have simply no acknowledgment of this deal", adding that seeing Trump acknowledge Hezbollah "has been an utter humiliation" for Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: Middle East Live: Iran says Trump 'betraying diplomacy' with blockade, excessive demands
item.description: An adviser to Iran's Supreme Leader ‌Mojtaba Khamenei ‌on Saturday said that US President Donald Trump was "betraying ‌diplomacy for the third ‌time" by continuing a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz and making what he described as excessive demands in negotiations to end the conflict. Follow our live blog for the latest updates.

item.title: Iran: Is Trump “Bored”?, Bolivia at “Breaking point” A Spanish Scandal
item.description:
It’s been a week where, 90 days into the conflict and ceasefire stand-off with Iran, both Tehran and Washington are insisting time is on their side — each claiming the other needs a deal more urgently.

item.title: What to Know About the Drones That Have Been Crossing Into Romania
item.description: The strike on Friday, near the Ukrainian border, was the first to injure civilians in Romania, officials say. But drones from the nearby war have been a growing threat.

item.title: Across the Middle East, Muslims Mark Eid Amid War and Crisis
item.description: From Iran to Gaza, Eid al-Adha celebrations were muted as war dragged on and shortages of food and fuel roiled the region.

item.title: Israel strikes hospital in southern Lebanon
item.description: Israel continues to hit targets in Lebanon despite a partial US-brokered ceasefire in place. Lebanese and Israeli diplomats are in Washington for the fourth round of direct talks, but those negotiations have been strongly opposed by Hezbollah. Pressure also mounting within Netanyahu's own government to continue the war in Lebanon.

item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israel Trades Strikes With Hezbollah, Leaving New Cease-Fire With Lebanon in Doubt
item.description: Hezbollah’s leader said the Iran-backed group, which was not included in U.S.-brokered talks, had rejected the deal.

item.title: Netanyahu says he has directed IDF to increase control of Gaza to 70%
item.description: The expansion in control by Israel would contradict the terms of the ceasefire Israel and Hamas agreed to in October 2025.

item.title: Friday briefing: ​What do the cuts in aid mean for the fight against Ebola in the DRC?
item.description:
In today’s newsletter: As the virus spreads across borders, health workers warn that weakened global support is making a prolonged crisis more likely
